name: @crucible/client
description: TypeScript client for a Crucible inference server. Zero runtime dependencies.
author: Owen Morgan

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/stamp-module-type.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test build/test/unit.test.js
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test build/test/e2e.test.js
